_meta.description: Common corridor headroom restricted by lowered drop-ceiling housing M&E services; measured clearance 1850 mm vs required 2000 mm

reference.verbatim_source: BCA Approved Document Ver 7.08 §C cl. C.3.2.1 — minimum 2000 mm headroom in habitable rooms / common circulation
reference.audit_source: BCA BPTOP industry sharing 2026 item 2 — Headroom & Ceiling Height (one of the top recurring NCs)

location: Common corridor, drop-ceiling section housing AHU ductwork / sprinkler main
description: Measured headroom of approximately 1850 mm below the lowered drop-ceiling section, against the 2000 mm minimum required for common circulation routes under Approved Document §C. The restriction is caused by the M&E plenum depth above the suspended ceiling. Affects fire-egress assumption for the corridor.
title: Low headroom, common corridor
